The comment "hong rảnh drammar lôi )) hiền tụi tao hiền" is written in informal Vietnamese with some slang and playful tone. "hong" is a colloquial form of "không" meaning "no" or "not". The phrase "hong rảnh drammar lôi" means "not free to stir up drama" or "not interested in causing drama". The double parentheses "))" indicate a lighthearted or joking tone. "hiền tụi tao hiền" means "we are gentle/kind" or "we are nice". Overall, the commenter is saying they are not interested in causing drama and that they are nice people, using a casual and friendly tone.
